strings: When m_c tried to eat, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had to quickly turn to r_c0 and ask for some anti-nausea herbs.
When m_c is hungry, that hunger manifests as a case of nausea.
m_c isn't able to finish {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} prey, leaving it half-eaten and {PRONOUN/m_c/object} looking like {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} might be sick.
